You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: The robot should first move the yellow_block from its current location (not on any zone) to the orange_tray, ensuring the tray is empty. Then, it should move the blue_book from the purple_box to the cyan_tray, ensuring the tray is empty. The robot must confirm that both objects are securely placed on their respective trays and that no object remains on the purple_box. Success is achieved when both objects are in their target zones and all zones are correctly cleared or assigned.
Goals: [{"object": "blue_book", "zone": "cyan_tray"}, {"object": "yellow_block", "zone": "orange_tray"}]
